encounters.weakness: The player's Volcanic Resonance Staff emits a harmonic frequency that disrupts the Wyrms' internal magma flow. When the staff is actively used, the Wyrms stagger and take 25% more damage per hit. This is their only vulnerability.

The Screamers are vulnerable to the Magma Crystal Shard's resonance. When the shard is held and activated, the Screamers emit a high-pitched shriek, causing them to stagger and take 50% damage per hit for 10 seconds. This effect is only active if the shard is in direct contact with the player's hand (must be worn or in inventory).

The Eruptive Heart is immune to direct elemental attacks. It only has one known vulnerability: the **Lava Core Fragment**. If the player holds the fragment and activates it at the moment the Heart's core pulses (every 90 seconds), a chain reaction occurs, causing a 3-second volcanic cascade that deals 200 damage to the Heart and triggers a temporary blind spot in its vision. This effect is only usable once per fight. Failure to use it during the correct pulse causes a 60-second global eruption that damages the player by 120 per second and reduces the player's staff power by 70%.
Flame Lance (igniting terrain triggers a defensive cooldown in the Wurm, reducing its ability to project acidic spits).
Ignition Core Shard (the shard's terrain ignition causes the Maw to stagger and lose its ability to summon acid mist for 5 seconds).
Fissure Bloom (only when the Fissure Bloom is active, the Sovereign's core becomes vulnerable to fire damage—reducing its health by 20% per second for 10 seconds when hit with a flame spell).
Holy Lance (player weapon) - reduces HP by 25% and causes scattering, disrupting formation and line of sight
Lava Resistant Cloak (pickup from Encounter 1) - reduces fire attack damage by 30%. When hit with Holy Strike, one head shatters and disables its attack for 3 seconds.
Holy Sigil Shard (collected in Encounter 2) — when used to cast Holy Light Surge, deals 60 damage and makes the boss vulnerable to all holy attacks for 5 seconds.
Ignis Bladefang (high thermal damage) - causes 30% additional damage on direct hits when weapon is fully charged, and reduces fire resistance by 50% for 3 seconds after a successful hit.

Molten Shard (Reactive Core) - when used during the attack phase, it inflicts a 30% debuff to the Wraith's regeneration and causes it to lose control, entering a stagger state for 4 seconds (during which it deals 50% less damage).

Furnace Pulse (Echo Shard) - must be activated exactly when the Sovereign is at 30% health or lower. The pulse triggers a resonance that disables its magma armor for 5 seconds, reducing its defense by 60% and allowing the player's Ignis Bladefang to deal 1.5x damage (maximum of 180 per hit). Failure to activate at the correct time results in a 10-second stagger and 200 damage taken from the Titan's wrath.

Lava-Resist Injector (player weapon) — the wisp shudders and fades when the injector is fired directly at it, reducing damage by 50% and halving its health. Firing at it once weakens it for the next encounter.

Circuit Shard (pickup from first encounter) — when the shard is used on the golem, it emits a crackling sound and its heat output drops to 50% for 3 seconds. The golem becomes vulnerable to fire and ice-based damage, reducing health by 25% per second during this period.

Circuit Shard (picked up in encounter 2) — if the player uses the Circuit Shard on the boss during the final phase, the boss enters 'Circuit Override' state. This reduces its damage by 70%, and its lava bursts are suppressed. The boss sings a low tone, indicating it's being 'reprogrammed'.
Stormshard Slicer's lightning pulse (frees floating ash particles, disrupts Magma Maw's breath attack).
Conductive Ash Shard (when active, causes Searing Vortex's energy field to flicker and destabilize, reducing its damage by 40% for 5 seconds).
Volcanic Static Coil (when activated, the Ignis Tempestus is stunned for 4 seconds and its fire bolts are redirected into harmless sparks).

Lava Geyser Club (player weapon) - hitting with the club causes a burst of rainbow lava that melts them instantly. A 'bloop' sound plays when hit, and they float up to dance after being defeated in a silly way.

Sunny Sparkle Mushroom (pickup from previous encounter) - when the mushroom glows near the frog, it makes them wobble and fall. They scream 'Glop!' and break into tiny bubbles when hit. They move quickly and jump randomly.

Frogs' Bounce Juice (pickup from encounter 2) - if the player activates the juice during a boss attack, the golem freezes in mid-bounce, and the player can strike it with the Lava Geyser Club to deal massive damage (x2 damage). The golem emits a 'pop!' sound and wobbles like a jelly.

Chrono-Backlash (Player Weapon) - Reduces attack speed by 40% and causes time to slow around the enemy during attacks. Applies 10% knockback on hit when weapon is fully charged and used in reverse-time mode.

Lava Pulse Shard (Pickup from prior encounter) - When activated, the enemy's movement slows by 50% and its time-based attacks stutter. If used during a time-stopped moment, the enemy's entire timeline flickers and collapses into a loop for 2 seconds.

Temporal Shard (Pickup from Encounter 2) - When the player uses the Temporal Shard in a time-reversal attack, the boss's core flickers and its internal time loop unravels for 4 seconds. This reveals a hidden pattern—the core is actually a frozen moment from the beginning of the volcano's eruption, and it can be stopped by reversing time at the exact moment of ignition. If used correctly, it causes a collapse of the flame's timeline for 3 seconds.

Aurora Blade (player weapon) - Holy light attacks deal 2x damage when the sword is fully charged and glowing. The Whisperer dissolves when struck by a full-strength holy beam from the sword, forming a glowing shard that floats upward and can be collected by the player.

Shard of Elyra (pickup from prior encounter) - When the player uses the Shard to 'activate' the guardian, the entity emits a soft pulse. If the player attacks with a holy beam while the shard is active, the Guardian's armor shatters and it weakens by 30%. The player must use the shard to initiate the attack pattern.

Luminous Seed (pickup from prior encounter) - The entity absorbs holy light. However, when the player uses the Luminous Seed in the center of their stance during combat, the entity becomes vulnerable and its health drains rapidly. The player must use the seed to initiate the weak phase — otherwise it regenerates health faster than the player can damage it. The seed must be active during the attack to trigger vulnerability.

Temporal Shard (rewound state). The weapon must be manually rewound to -1.5 seconds before engaging the enemy. After rewinding, the Chrono-Weaver's time loops freeze at random intervals, creating vulnerability windows. This is the only way to damage it.

Flicker Shard. The enemy spawns in a frozen time bubble. Using the Flicker Shard during its time reversal causes a stutter that reveals its true form — a dormant temporal core. This allows the player to land a critical hit (150% damage).

Echo Resonance. The enemy manifests as a rotating time spiral. When Echo Resonance is used, it disrupts the vortex's harmonic frequency, causing it to collapse into a stable, still state for 3 seconds. This is the only window to attack it. After 3 seconds, it reactivates with increased damage and speed. Cannot be damaged without using Echo Resonance.

Shadowblade (player weapon) — attacks the player in bursts that burn shadow energy. A direct strike with the blade consumes the vessel's heat, causing it to implode and emit a pulse of cold darkness. First strike must be precise and unmissable to trigger vulnerability. After 3 seconds, the vessel pulses and regenerates 30 HP. If player fails, the ring collapses and spawns a new vessel with 50% more HP and faster attack rate (escalation).

Fragment of the Hollow Star — when this item is held, the crawler's limbs become unstable. Its 3-phase attack (stagger, pull, bite) fails, and it emits a low-frequency hum that weakens its body. After 12 seconds, the crawler becomes vulnerable to a single shadowblade strike. If the player fails to activate the item in time, the crawler absorbs the player's shadow energy and grows stronger (gains 50 HP and +20% attack speed). The hum echoes and triggers a secondary spawn after 10 seconds. Must be defeated before the nebula collapses completely or the player is consumed by the void field.

Veil of Fractured Light — only when the Veil is *fully active* (i.e., the player holds it during the final strike) does the core's center become unstable. When the Veil is active, the core emits a burst of fractured starlight, exposing its true form: a dying star that once was a beacon. The core only takes 10% of damage from this exposure — but it takes 30 seconds to activate the Veil, and it must be held through the entire final phase. If the Veil is not used, the core absorbs player's shadow and grows stronger (regains 150 HP per second).
Starlight Weaver Staff (Flicker Veil illusion creates false shadow that makes the ant stumble)
Glowing Dust of Echoes (duplicate Flicker Veil causes confusion and spinning)
Shimmering Mirror Shard (when used with illusion, creates a false self that confuses the Weaver and makes it freeze)
Shattered Thundershock (direct lightning strike, 30% chance of critical hit with 2.5x damage if weapon is charged above 60%)
Tangled Current (when the current is in motion, it causes Sonic Maw to lose 15% control, causing it to spin and lose aim for 3 seconds).

Stormroot Core (when activated, nullifies 100% of all celestial manipulation and forces the Titan to become vulnerable to lightning. Must be used during the final 5 seconds of combat or the Titan becomes immune to all energy-based attacks).
Luminous Composite Bow arrows (blue energy disrupts its shadow-matter form; only active when player is using bow in ranged mode).
Shard of Cold Starlight (when used within 2m of enemy, the shard pulses and triggers a freeze effect — 20% damage reduction for 4 seconds, and a 1-second stun).

Frost-Scrap Gauntlet (when used while the Sentinel is in 'charge mode' — detected by a red pulse in its core — the Gauntlet emits a shockwave that freezes the Sentinel's energy flow. Requires direct use on the core. Cannot be used without the Gauntlet in hand.)

The Echo-Weaver is weak to the Ceramic Resonance Shard's harmonic frequency. When struck by the CRS, it shatters into 3 temporary echoes — each echoing the player's last movement. The player can use this to predict and counter-attack.

The Void-Crystallizer is immune to physical and sonic attacks but is vulnerable to 'crystalline disruption' — a property only active when the player wields a weapon that was previously used on an enemy. The player must have used the Ceramic Resonance Shard against the Echo-Weaver to trigger this vulnerability. The enemy will phase into a crystalline form when exposed to the shard's resonance, and then shatter if hit by a full-strength CRS attack.

The Weeping Celestial is only vulnerable when struck by a *Fractal Lattice Core* in direct resonance with the harmonic frequency of the **Harmonic Fragment**. The fragment must be used within 5 seconds of the core's activation. This creates a 'cosmic dissonance' — a wave that momentarily disables the entity and allows one full-attack burst. If the player fails to activate the resonance, the entity absorbs the fragment and grows stronger, and the player is locked in a loop where all enemies spawn every 3 seconds.
Welding Beam Cannon (core node destruction)
Core Conduit Fragment (must place on charging node to trigger collapse)
Core Conduit Fragment (must be placed directly into the central node to trigger resonance pulse)
